summary: Verify Wi-Fi settings screen lists available networks
description: Regression test for the Network & Internet settings screen. Confirms the Wi-Fi section is reachable and shows at least one entry when networks are in range.
preconditions: Device/emulator is powered on and unlocked
At least one Wi-Fi network is broadcasting in range

testSteps.expectedResult: Wi-Fi settings screen opens showing a toggle and a network list
Network scan completes and at least one network name is visible
